topic: 限时听力：学术独白与阶段测评
grammarFocus: 学术句子的主干、修饰关系与名词短语；被动表达。
title: Timed Listening and Staged Assessment in University Study
prompt: Some universities now assess students through short, timed listening tasks in which they hear an academic monologue once and then answer questions, replacing longer take-home assignments. Some educators argue that this format develops the focused listening and quick judgement students need, while others believe it unfairly penalises learners who process information more slowly or who are anxious under time pressure. To what extent do you agree or disagree that timed listening assessments should play a major role in university courses? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类 Task 2 练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确你的立场（完全同意、部分同意或不同意），再围绕“限时听力评估是否应在大学课程中占重要地位”展开论证。建议用 2–3 个主体段：每段先给出清晰的分论点，再用解释或假设性例子支撑，避免只罗列观点。注意回应题目中提到的两种对立看法（培养专注听力与快速判断 vs. 对慢速处理者和易焦虑者不公平），并说明你的立场如何回应这些争议。全文不少于 250 词，建议用 5 分钟规划、30–35 分钟写作、5 分钟检查，重点检查论点是否始终围绕“限时听力评估的重要性”这一核心。
